Mezcla arroz, garbanzos y brócoli. Sal,: Mix the rice, chickpeas and broccoli. Salt, pepper, paprika, raw oil.
Mezcla con el arroz caliente. Sal y pimi: Mix it with the hot rice. Salt and pepper.
Mezcla con el arroz integral caliente y: Mix it with the hot brown rice and the cauliflower. Salt, pepper, paprika, raw oil.
Mezcla con el trigo sarraceno caliente (: Mix it with the hot buckwheat (separate the grains with a fork) and the carrot. Pepper.
Mezcla con la patata y el brócoli. Sal,: Mix it with the potato and the broccoli. Salt, pepper, and a little tomato sauce to keep it moist.
Mezcla con la patata y el calabacín. Pim: Mix it with the potato and the courgette. Pepper.
Mezcla con la patata y la coliflor. Sal,: Mix it with the potato and the cauliflower. Salt, pepper, paprika.
Mezcla con la quinoa caliente (ahuécala: Mix it with the hot quinoa (fluff it up with a fork).
Mezcla con la quinoa caliente. Sal, pimi: Mix it with the hot quinoa. Salt, pepper, paprika if you have some.
Mezcla con la quinoa y el brócoli, y sal: Mix it with the quinoa and the broccoli, and salt at the end.
Mezcla con las verduras y la quinoa cali: Mix it with the vegetables and the hot quinoa. Pepper.
Mezcla con los champiñones y la quinoa c: Mix it with the mushrooms and the hot quinoa. Soy sauce or salt, pepper.
Mix it with the potato and the pepper. Pepper.
Mezcla cuscús, carne y zanahoria. Sal, p: Mix the couscous, meat and carrot. Salt, pepper, paprika or cumin if you have some.
Mezcla cuscús, pavo y calabacín. Sal, pi: Mix the couscous, turkey and courgette. Salt, pepper, paprika.
Mezcla cuscús, pavo y champiñones. Pimie: Mix the couscous, turkey and mushrooms. Pepper and raw oil.
Mix the rice with the broccoli.
Mezcla el arroz con el maíz y pon el atú: Mix the rice with the sweetcorn and put the tuna on top in chunks.
Mix the rice with the carrot.
Mezcla el arroz con las espinacas y pon: Mix the rice with the spinach and put the king prawns on top.
Mezcla el atún con el queso fresco batid: Mix the tuna with the quark to bind it, and serve it with the cucumber alongside or on top. Pepper and lemon.
Mezcla el cuscús con el calabacín, pon l: Mix the couscous with the courgette, put the sardines on top in pieces and a squeeze of lemon.
Mezcla el cuscús con el pollo y el tomat: Mix the couscous with the chicken and the tomato. Raw oil and pepper.
Mezcla el cuscús con las verduras y pon: Mix the couscous with the vegetables and put the sea bass on top. Lemon.
Mezcla el cuscús con los champiñones y u: Mix the couscous with the mushrooms and a pinch of pepper.
Mix the couscous with the mushrooms.
Mezcla el cuscús con los pimientos y sir: Mix the couscous with the peppers and serve with the pork. Pepper.
Mezcla el pavo con los pimientos 1 minut: Mix the turkey with the peppers for 1 minute and turn it off.
Mezcla el queso fresco batido con la ave: Mix the quark with the oats in a bowl and let it stand for 5 or 10 minutes: raw oats straight in stay gritty.
Mezcla el requesón con la avena en un bo: Mix the ricotta with the oats in a bowl and let it stand for 5 or 10 minutes so the oats soften.
Mezcla el yogur con la avena y déjalo re: Mix the yoghurt with the oats and let it stand for 5 minutes if you can.
Mezcla en un bol el queso fresco batido: In a bowl, mix the quark with the tuna until it is an even paste.
Mezcla la avena con el yogur en un bote: Mix the oats with the yoghurt in a jar or a bowl. Here the ratio is ONE of oats to TWO of yoghurt, half the liquid of a hot porridge.
Mezcla la pasta con el cerdo cortado y u: Toss the pasta with the sliced pork and a splash of the reserved water.
Mezcla la pasta con el pollo cortado y u: Toss the pasta with the sliced chicken and a splash of that water.
Mezcla la pasta escurrida con el tomate: Toss the drained pasta with the raw tomato and the chicken: the heat of the pasta is enough for the tomato.
Mezcla la pasta ya cocida con el calabac: Toss the cooked pasta with the courgette and two tablespoons of water; serve with the sliced fillet.
Mezcla la pasta ya cocida con la zanahor: Toss the cooked pasta with the carrot, the tofu and two tablespoons of water. Soy sauce or salt, pepper.
Mezcla la patata con el huevo batido y D: Mix the potato with the beaten egg and LET IT STAND FOR 10 MINUTES. That rest is what makes it taste like a tortilla rather than egg with potatoes next to it.
Mezcla la quinoa con el calabacín y pon: Mix the quinoa with the courgette and put the salmon on top. Lemon and pepper.
Mezcla la quinoa con las espinacas cruda: Mix the quinoa with the raw spinach and the warm chicken.
Mezcla la quinoa con las espinacas y pon: Mix the quinoa with the spinach and put the salmon on top. Lemon at the end.
Mezcla la quinoa con las verduras y el a: Mix the quinoa with the vegetables and the tuna and dress it with a tablespoon of olive oil and salt.
Mezcla la quinoa, las espinacas crudas,: Mix the quinoa, the raw spinach, the chicken and the avocado with a tablespoon of oil, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Eat it warm or cold.
Mezcla los dos en un bol. La combinación: Mix the two in a bowl. The combination works on contrast, so cut the apple just before eating so it stays crisp.
Mezcla patata y brócoli, reparte la caba: Mix the potato and broccoli, scatter the mackerel over the top. Lemon, pepper, raw oil.
Mezcla todo 30 segundos y sirve. Limón y: Mix everything for 30 seconds and serve. Lemon and pepper.
Mezcla todo con cuidado. Un chorrito de: Mix everything carefully. A splash of vinegar at the end lifts the lentils. Salt and pepper.
Mezcla todo con el arroz caliente y un c: Mix everything with the hot rice and a splash of soy sauce or salt.
Mezcla todo con la quinoa y prueba de sa: Mix everything with the quinoa and check the seasoning.
Mezcla todo. Un chorrito de vinagre leva: Mix everything. A splash of vinegar lifts the lentils. Salt and pepper.
Mezcla y sirve. Limón, pimienta, aceite: Mix and serve. Lemon, pepper, raw oil.
Mézclala con el skyr y espolvorea canela: Mix it with the skyr and dust cinnamon over the top. Half a teaspoon is plenty: overdo the cinnamon and it buries every other flavour.
Mézclalo con los cacahuetes (mejor sin s: Mix it with the peanuts (unsalted for preference, or shake the salt off).
Mézclalo en un bol con el queso fresco b: Mix it in a bowl with the quark until it is spreadable.
Mézclalo JUSTO antes de comer: la piña f: Mix it JUST before eating: fresh pineapple turns ricotta to liquid if you leave them mixed and standing.
Mézclalo todo con cuidado. Si te molesta: Mix everything carefully. If the bones bother you, split them lengthways with the fork and pull the central thread: it comes out in one piece.
Mézclalo todo y aliña con aceite de oliv: Mix everything and dress it with olive oil and salt just before eating.
Mix everything and dress it with olive oil and salt.
Mézclalos y aliña con una cucharadita de: Mix them and dress with a teaspoon of oil and a few drops of lemon. Pepper.
Honey if you want it sweeter.
Mientras hierve, seca la pechuga, sálala: While it boils, pat the breast dry, salt it and griddle it for 4-5 minutes a side.
Mientras, corta las salchichas en rodaja: Meanwhile, cut the sausages into finger-thick slices and brown them in the pan WITHOUT oil, 3-4 minutes: they render plenty of fat on their own. Let them take colour; underdone they release water and the dish ends up bland.
Mientras, cuece el brócoli 4 minutos en: Meanwhile, boil the broccoli for 4 minutes in salted boiling water and drain it well.
Mientras, cuece el brócoli en agua hirvi: Meanwhile, boil the broccoli in salted boiling water for 4 minutes: it should stay bright green and give when pierced, not go soft.
Mientras, escurre la lata de caballa inc: Meanwhile, drain the tin of mackerel by tipping it with the lid half on.
Mientras, hidrata el cuscús con agua hir: Meanwhile, soak the couscous with boiling water a finger above it, covered, 5 minutes off the heat, then separate the grains with a fork.
Mientras, hidrata el cuscús: en un bol,: Meanwhile, soak the couscous: in a bowl, covered with boiling water a finger above it, a plate on top, 5 minutes OFF the heat.
Mientras, lava la lechuga hoja a hoja, s: Meanwhile, wash the lettuce leaf by leaf, dry it and tear it up with your hands.
Mientras, lava la zanahoria, pélala y có: Meanwhile, wash the carrot, peel it and cut it into sticks. Peel the eggs starting from the fat end, which is where the air pocket is.
Mientras, plancha la pechuga seca y sala: Meanwhile, griddle the breast, dried and salted, for 4-5 minutes a side.
Mientras, saca la pechuga de la nevera y: Meanwhile, take the breast out of the fridge and pat it dry with paper. If it is very thick, butterfly it open so it cooks through.
Mientras, tuesta el pan y machaca el agu: Meanwhile, toast the bread and mash the avocado with a fork straight onto the toast, with a pinch of salt.
Moja el pan 10 segundos POR CADA LADO, n: Dip the bread for 10 seconds ON EACH SIDE, no longer. This is the classic mistake: leaving it to soak wets it through to the middle and it falls apart in the pan.
Monta con el tomate en rodajas y las esp: Build it up with the sliced tomato and the spinach, and let it sit for 1 minute before closing it.
Monta el arroz de base con el pollo y el: Build it on a base of rice with the chicken and the edamame on top.
Monta el arroz de base y coloca encima e: Build it on a base of rice and arrange the tuna, the avocado and the cucumber on top in separate areas rather than mixing it all together: that way you choose what goes in each spoonful.
Monta el arroz de base, el brócoli al la: Build it on a base of rice, the broccoli alongside and the prawns on top.
